headline: Long-horizon AI and semiconductor theses remain broadly intact, but today's tape is skewing defensive, crowded, and digestion-heavy.

today.thesis: NVDA remains in a powerful uptrend and Mytutopia RSI 76.7 / VEL5 +13.3 says momentum has not broken. But after a +4.39% breakout day, with premarket now ~2.5% red and China/H200 headlines back in play, the more likely path is a choppy consolidation / modest fade rather than another clean impulse higher.

30d.thesis: - Direction: up - Confidence: 60/100 - Expected price range: $220.00 - $290.00 - Range framing: anchored to the 2026-05-14 regular close. Wide because the May 20 earnings event can easily reprice the stock by double digits. - Brief thesis: The 30-day base case remains bullish because the structural demand story still points the right way: Blackwell demand, Rubin visibility, enterprise-agent moat expansion, and supportive mega-cap AI-capex read-throughs. RSI 76.7 / VEL5 +13.3 tells me the entry is crowded, not that the thesis is broken. - Key drivers: earnings beat/guide quality; Data Center revenue trajectory; management commentary on Blackwell, Rubin, and supply; China/export-control tone; post-earnings analyst target revisions. - Falsifiers: underwhelming guide; clear gross-margin degradation; new evidence that custom silicon or customer digestion is biting faster than expected; failed hold of the breakout zone after earnings.

1y.thesis: - Direction: up - Confidence: 67/100 - Expected price range: $210.00 - $425.00 - Range framing: anchored to the 2026-05-14 regular close. - Brief thesis: The long-duration thesis remains that NVIDIA still has the best full-stack monetization position in AI infrastructure: chips, systems, networking, CUDA, and increasingly application/runtime control. The current technical overextension matters very little at this horizon except as a reminder that path risk will be high. - Key drivers: Blackwell-to-Rubin execution; sustained AI infrastructure capex; deeper enterprise lock-in; continued FCF generation and optional capital returns; ability to stay the system bottleneck rather than just a component vendor. - Falsifiers: structural AI-capex slowdown; real customer insourcing pressure; severe policy shock around China; major margin compression or valuation compression that persists beyond one quarter.
